Hearthstone Hospice, Intake Coordinator Fax (314) 555-0166
RE: Almaz Tesfaye Gebreyes; also known as Almaz Gebreyes Mehari on her insurance card; DOB April 17, 2006; MRN 0612-884
Dear Colleague,
Thank you for seeing this seventy-six year old lady, a Tigrinya speaking woman who came to this country as a refugee in 2052 and whom I have known now for many years. I am referring her for hospice evaluation and enrolment. She lives with her husband, Tekle Mehari, who is himself ninety-one (91, though his chart in our system lists him as 9 1, which is wrong) and who is fully independent and quite deaf. Their daughter Rahel is nearby and their son Daniel lives out of state.
Her medical history is long. She had a traumatic brain injury as a child in 2013, hypertension since 2050, ischaemic heart disease diagnosed in November 2070 with the usual regimen, and type two diabetes with kidney involvement, now at stage 3 with a creatinine of 2.0 and an eGFR of about 40. In November 2074 she was found to have a breast malignancy and she underwent chemotherapy followed by an autologous bone marrow transplant in March 2075, from which she recovered well. She had a clavicle fracture in October 2078 and a wrist fracture in November 2080 after a fall on the stairs in the building, and a mild coronavirus infection in June 2080. Her chronic obstructive bronchitis however has been steadily worsening over the past year and she is now breathless on minimal exertion, which is the reason for this referral. We have discussed goals of care at length, with an interpreter, Mr. Yohannes, on the telephone, and she and her family agree that she wishes to be at home and comfortable. She does not want to be resuscitated. Her husband would like us to note that she "is 76 but acts 60".
Current medicines are clopidogrel, metoprolol succinate, simvastatin, and nitroglycerin spray as needed. Please contact her daughter, Rahel Mehari, at (314) 555-0172 or the patient on (314) 555-0188. Her landlord, Mr. Ostrowski of Ostrowski Realty, has agreed to put in a hospital bed on the ground floor, in a unit that is now Apt 2A, although the address on file is 1840 Delmar Boulevard, Apt 6C.
I would be most grateful for your assistance.
With kind regards,
Thandiwe Mokoena, MBChB, FCP(SA) Consultant Physician
